_comment: Golden cases for model output-column inference — the CROSS-REPO contract.
visivo and core each implement this independently: visivo in
the runner image ships it; pulling it into the Django web image would drag
every warehouse driver along), so the logic exists twice on purpose.
This file is the single source of truth that keeps them honest. visivo's
assert the same answers. Core locates it via a sibling ../visivo checkout,
which is how its CI already vendors the viewer.
Add a case here when you change inference in either repo.

cases.name: named columns resolve their types from the source schema
star expands from the source schema
aliases are the output names
cases.sql: SELECT id AS order_id, amount AS total FROM orders

cases.name: an unknown table resolves nothing, and is not an error
unparseable SQL resolves nothing, and is not an error
no cached source schema still resolves literal projections
a nested schema block (source with named schemas) resolves
SQL comments do not break column resolution
cases.sql: SELECT id /* the key */, amount FROM orders
